name: Exact AMR Rendering
definition: Rendering AMR (Adaptive Mesh Refinement) gas cells as piecewise-constant cubic cells rather than SPH particles. Each cell is a cube of side 'smooth', volume mass/rho, with edges aligned to the original simulation axes.
summary: Exact AMR Rendering treats AMR cells as piecewise-constant geometric cubes to ensure mass conservation and geometric fidelity, avoiding the smoothing and orthographic approximations of other methods.
